name: initialize a mailing-list server stack
definition: bring up a postfix-smtp and the mailing-list daemon so unsolicited mail input is routed to the list processor
failure_mode: the processors not started to route mail

name: inject the crafted task into the queue the worker consumes
definition: Write the payload onto the correct broker queue in the supported protocol so the worker picks it up (authenticate route selection and the queue/body/headers expected by the worker).
